notice.default:
[Draft: the company replaces this wording in Settings.] What you tell us is kept confidential: only the staff who handle grievances can read it, and you can stay anonymous.

No one will be punished or treated unfairly for raising a grievance.

When you send it, you get a reference number and a PIN. Use them on this site to see what is happening and to read our replies.
poster.scan: Scan with your phone camera. You can stay anonymous.
received.advice: Write both down now, or take a photo of this screen. You need both to see progress and read replies. The PIN cannot be shown again.
received.done_hint: Press Done once you have them, so the next person using this phone cannot see them.
received.emailed: We have also sent them to your email.
received.next: Staff will look at your grievance. Come back to this site with your reference number and PIN to see what is happening and to read their replies.
